trigger_cases.query: Write the README for this CLI tool.
Draft a PRD for the billing feature.
Turn these meeting notes into a design doc.
Rewrite the tool descriptions for our MCP server.
Add a changelog entry for v2.1.
Clean up the wording in this API reference.
Write a handoff note for the next agent that picks this up.
Tighten the prompt in this skill file.
Make this spec read more clearly for the next agent.
Polish the wording of our contribution guide.
Give me a quick summary of this repository.
Write a launch tweet announcing the release.
Fix the grammar in my personal essay.
Explain what Simplified Technical English means.
Summarize this pull request for me.
Write a short story about a robot.
Draft a reply to this customer email.

output_cases.prompt: Rewrite this paragraph for a README: 'The system is extremely robust and leverages cutting-edge techniques to facilitate seamless data processing at scale.'
assertions: No superlative or intensifier remains (extremely, cutting-edge, seamless).
The result replaces each quality claim with a measure or an explicit slot, and invents no fact.

output_cases.prompt: Write a README section that explains how to install the acme CLI. The install command is `npm install -g acme`.
assertions: Every sentence is 20 words or fewer.

output_cases.prompt: Rewrite this spec sentence so an agent cannot confuse the terms: 'The client sends a request, then the caller issues a query and the service handles the invocation.'
assertions: One term is used for one concept throughout.
No synonym cycling remains (request, call, invocation, query).
